name: feature-grid-spotlight
title: Feature Grid Spotlight
description: A 3x2 interactive feature grid with dynamic cursor hover spotlighting, category tags, and expandable detail states.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Feature Grid Spotlight Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
